CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation related to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n3/red) is listed, its presentation/access is marked as current, and a separate origin/status field is present for the same referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to the identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content:attribute lines identify contents and attributes (e.g., red/blue coordinates) with time labels.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (e.g. history_estimate, command_estimate) are provided separately from content coordinates, distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The report labels items as current/candidate and provides explicit organizational patterns and grid orientation, indicating presentation/access and structural organization.
